english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an official application, including an officer's request for public-service supplies.
This is the all-purpose noun for a request for a job, place, service, or course.

examples.english: Our police station needed new uniforms, so I submitted a requisition to my superior.
examples.traditional: 警署要添置新制服，我填咗份申請交畀上司。

examples.english: I want to submit an application for that part-time job.
